lectures.title: Efficient Command Execution: the variable PATH

cues.en: Let's now have a look at one of the most important environment variables, the variable path.
This is extremely important.
It pretty much just stores a list of directories, but it's important because those directory are searched
for executable programs whenever we want to execute a program.
The order here matters.
Those directories are searched from the left to the right.
Multiple directories are separated by colons, so everything is in this one variable and this is responsible
for enabling us to easily execute programs.
